edits.old: - This story has no build dependency, so it is ready on Day 1.
edits.new:
- This story has no build dependency, so it is ready on Day 1.
- The export access entry is read back through the P4 access-log contract with event code AC-EXPT and the filters and row count in the entry; the masking rules are P4's and are applied over the P1 masked view columns; owner display names are synthetic in SIT (GAP-0355).
- The scope predicate is carried in the authorise answer of rwb-access and applied to each case ID inside the query; the case facts come from the P3 case read, and a chain-mismatch incident goes to the Compliance queue read from platform configuration (GAP-1245).
- The matrix, role and masking tables stay with P4 rwb-access, and the entity registry and ACE views stay with P1 rwb-source-data; the parameters and LOV load stay with P3 rwb-case; the masked read is proven through the P1 data product contract, and the guard and masker are the platform library, asserted through P4 and P1 (GAP-0358).
- The masking decision for interaction.summary comes from the rwb-access authorise contract under DP-08; P1 keeps no masking row of its own, and data_product_access is read as P1's data product access catalogue (GAP-0584).
- A failed authorise call is refused (fail-closed); the cache lifetime is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0161).

edits.old: The H, C and X lists of this story are exactly those of the metadata table: no H, no C, no X, and the three I dependencies RWB-P1-E1069-APP, RWB-PLT-E1037-APP and RWB-P4-E1037-APP. An ITG story waits on no build of its own.
edits.new: The H, C and X lists of this story are exactly those of the metadata table: no H, no C, no X, and the three I dependencies RWB-P1-E1069-APP, RWB-PLT-E1037-APP and RWB-P4-E1037-APP. The H and C lists of the owning APP stories are read as the platform and published contracts the DP table names; this story's Depends on (build) stays None and it stays Ready to start at Day 1 (GAP-2414).
